description.summary: The caster emulates Barbariccia’s ability to unleash a black, draining wind upon their enemies
description.value: The caster emulates Barbariccia’s ability to unleash a black, draining wind upon their enemies. All enemies in a 20-ft.-radius burst, with a range of 30 feet, must make a Fortitude save or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. Learned From Barbariccia, Garuda ‘Creature’, Kaiser Dragon, and Storm Dragon
